intro: Isaiah is the prophet of judgement and hope, writing about seven hundred years before Christ.
Chapters one to thirty-nine warn Jerusalem and the nations, but shine with promises: a child to be born, and a coming king of peace.
Chapters forty to sixty-six begin with: Comfort ye my people. They speak of return from exile, the suffering servant, and new heavens and a new earth.
Christians hear Jesus in many of its words. Listen for chapter fifty-three, and for the promise: they shall mount up with wings as eagles.
